origin.description: Prepend a library directory, then restore the list.
origin.details: Paths must exist. prefix, suffix, and replace match R's merge of the new paths with .libPaths().
origin.example:
dir.create("/tmp/withr-lib-check", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
before <- .libPaths()
first <- local({
  local_libpaths("/tmp/withr-lib-check", action = "prefix")
  normalizePath(.libPaths()[[1]])
})
c(first, if (identical(.libPaths(), before)) "restored" else "open")

translation.description: Prepend a library directory, then restore the list.
translation.details: Paths must exist. prefix, suffix, and replace match R's merge of the new paths with .libPaths(). code is a callable, and local_* is a context manager.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from withr import *

os.makedirs("/tmp/withr-lib-check", exist_ok=True)
before = libpaths()
with local_libpaths("/tmp/withr-lib-check", action="prefix"):
    first = libpaths()[0]
flag = "restored" if libpaths() == before else "open"
return [first, flag]
